notes_zh:
Sekiro Mod Manager v0.3.0 重构正式版
- 采用纯 C++17 与 Qt 6 / QML (HuskarUI) 全新架构
- 毫秒级 NTFS 零拷贝硬链接极速部署与纯净还原
- 自动化 6 层压缩包递归寻根解析与散装文件启发式归位
- 沉浸式高斯模糊模组底图与细粒度资产级独立启停
- ModEngine 全景健康诊断与一键修复注入向导
- 软件内置一键自动就地热重装引擎
notes_en:
Sekiro Mod Manager v0.3.0 Major Release
- Rebuilt with modern C++17, Qt 6 / QML, and HuskarUI
- Instantaneous zero-copy NTFS hardlink deployment and pristine rollback
- Recursive 6-level nested archive extraction with loose file signature heuristics
- Immersive blurred backdrop cards with fine-grained per-file asset toggling
- ModEngine environment health diagnostics and one-click provisioning
- Built-in zero-installer hot in-place auto-update engine
